column1: # The about() pass (Peter 2026-10-16: "maybe we should have a lot more about() in core"): a field of study, or a kind of
# information, is filed under about(X) for what it is about. about follows the graph and in(...) (ROLES.md), so
# about(dog) ⊑ about(animal), and a subfield inherits its field's subject: each edge was checked against every node below it.
# Witnesses: Wikidata P2578 "studies" (fetched 2026-10-16), the WordNet gloss ("the branch of X that studies Y"), Claude's reading.
# Rows use parent+ (the node keeps its kind parents). Each note opens with its witnesses: wikidata (P2578), wn-gloss (the WordNet
# gloss names the subject), wn-domain (WordNet's topic-domain members of the field fall under the subject), claude (Claude's reading only).
# Applied by tools/step7.py after the other rulings files.
